column1: # murmurent choreography index — machine-readable form, read by
# One row per published choreography: name <TAB> git_url
# LOCATIONS ONLY. This file deliberately carries no titles, summaries or
# counts. Everything a reader is shown comes from the choreography's own
# `.murmurent.yaml`, read at install time, so a description here could never
# drift away from the repository it describes. `name` must match the `name`
# field in that file, because that is what an install-by-name resolves.
# Adding a row: the repository must be public, must declare
# `kind: choreography` in `.murmurent.yaml` at its root, and should carry its
# decision records and failure catalogue (see docs/choreography.md in the code
# repo — for a choreography the written substrate is part of the result and
# ships). Open a PR against this file.
# Data is never included. A choreography repository carries code, decisions and
# documentation; its data lives under the centre's own governed data root.
